title: Separate inventory ownership, custody, source, site, and eligibility
rationale: Recorded Owner, Custodian, Inventory Site, supplier/source, Stock State, and Use Constraints answer different operational questions and must never be inferred from one another. A Stock Holding is the smallest independently allocatable compatibility pool. Physical Stock Containers are optional carrier detail; a partner aggregate is a Partner Stock Balance with source, as-of time, confidence, and evidence, never a fictional reel or lot.

title: Treat reservations and local floors as allocation policy, not movement
rationale: A Stock Movement changes quantity, Recorded Owner, Custodian, Inventory Site, or Storage Location. A Material Reservation is a time-bounded claim for named demand, while a Stock Floor is a standing site minimum such as Keep local. Neither changes on-hand quantity. Allocatable Quantity must be calculated conservatively for named demand after eligibility, other allocations, and protected floors; no universal available total is valid.

content: Distributed-inventory UI is progressive and exception-first. Default to one compact searchable table; show local, partner-held, reserved/protected, in-transit/quarantine, and local-floor facts separately; add Allocatable for this build only in an explicit demand context. Open a part side sheet grouped by Inventory Site and Custodian, then reveal carriers/evidence/history one level deeper. Keep Receive, Move, Reserve, and Keep local as focused common actions and require deterministic 1280x800 semantic, accessibility, screenshot, and agent visual-review evidence for each user-facing tracer.

name: Transfer distributed stock through one in-transit position
description: Model dispatch and destination receipt as separate idempotent facts with one In-Transit Stock position between them. Count material once, conserve whole-piece quantity, preserve owner/lot/allocation provenance, and create a separately traceable child for partial physical transfers. When planned supply becomes Inventory, stop counting the same pieces as Procurement inbound. Partner reconciliation retains source/as-of/confidence history and never invents carrier or lot detail.
